verdict.rationale: Eqvista sells in-house 409A valuations bundled with its cap table plan, performed by NACVA-certified analysts, which supports audit-readiness. The plan includes unlimited 409A valuations for 12 months plus expedite options. A real-time, app-based common stock valuation view, enabled through a 'Real-time Valuation' menu, is pitched as replacing static 409A reports, which implies the valuation is tied to platform data. Missing for 10: an explicit in-app ordering workflow, documentation that the valuation is generated directly from live cap table data, a defined scheduled-refresh cadence (only 'unlimited for 12 months' is evidenced), and independent or hands-on corroboration of the 409A service.
